entries.59a8cc55191f8fcc: A business that handles comprehensive planning and production of campaigns, events, exhibitions, TV commercials and other activities in line with client companies’ sales strategies. The company and its consolidated subsidiaries Kurei Inc. and Makkurei Inc. handle this business, mainly receiving comprehensive planning orders from client companies and advertising agencies. Revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥6,176 million.
entries.830937fb61f44e0a: A business that uses video infrastructure, such as digital video editing studios, to handle the actual production of video. It rents and operates video systems, special effects systems and business presentation equipment used at events, exhibitions, concerts, academic conferences and meetings, and edits video for TV commercials and programs, and produces DVDs, Blu-ray discs and CG. Revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥7,242 million.
entries.a31ce6e0cc843fa5: It plans and produces sales promotion (SP), exhibitions, campaigns, expositions and other events, as well as showrooms and exhibition facilities.
entries.b42736e65135f4be: An advertising and video planning and production company responsible for planning and producing events and television commercials, and for actual production such as video equipment rental and video editing.
